value.original: An air terminal is a terminating or origination point for the transfer of air between distribution system(s) and one or more spaces. It can also be used for the transfer of air between adjacent spaces.

row.value: Un terminal de aire es donde empieza o finaliza la transferencia de aire entre el sistema(s) de distribución y uno o más espacios. También se puede utilizar para la transferencia de aire entre espacios adyacentes.
es-ES

value.original: An alarm is a device that signals the existence of a condition or situation that is outside the boundaries of normal expectation or that activates such a device.

row.value: An alarm is a device that signals the existence of a condition or situation that is outside the boundaries of normal expectation or that activates such a device.
EN

value.original: An [[IfcBeam]] is typically a horizontal, or nearly horizontal, structural member that is capable of withstanding load primarily by resisting bending. It may also represent such a member from an architectural point of view. It is not required to be load bearing.

row.value: Un [[IfcBeam]] es típicamente un elemento estructural horizontal, o casi horizontal, que es capaz de soportar la carga principalmente resistiendo a flexión. También puede representar a una parte desde el punto de vista arquitectónico. No es necesario que soporte carga.
es-ES

value.original: [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] represents major components as subordinate parts of a building element. Typical usage examples include precast concrete sandwich walls, where the layers may have different geometry representations. In this case the layered material representation does not sufficiently describe the element. Each layer is represented by an own instance of the [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] with its own geometry description.

row.value: [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] represents major components as subordinate parts of a building element. Typical usage examples include precast concrete sandwich walls, where the layers may have different geometry representations. In this case the layered material representation does not sufficiently describe the element. Each layer is represented by an own instance of the [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] with its own geometry description.
EN

value.original: The [[IfcBuildingElementProxy]] is a proxy definition that provides the same functionality as subtypes of [[IfcBuiltElement]], but without having a predefined meaning of the special type of building element it represents.

row.value: [[IfcBuildingElementProxy]] es un elemento constructivo que proporciona la misma funcionalidad que los subtipos de [[IfcBuiltElement]], pero sin tener un significado predeterminado del tipo de elemento constructivo que representa.
es-ES

value.original: A cable carrier fitting is a fitting that is placed at junction or transition in a cable carrier system.

row.value: Una unión de soporte de cables es un accesorio que se coloca en la unión o transición de un sistema de soporte de cables.
es-ES

value.original: A cable carrier segment is a flow segment that is specifically used to carry and support cabling.

row.value: Un tramo de soporte de cables es un segmento de flujo que se utiliza específicamente para transportar y soportar cableado.
es-ES

value.original: An [[IfcColumn]] is a vertical structural or architectural member which often is aligned with a structural grid intersection. In most cases it represents a vertical, or nearly vertical, structural member that transmits, through compression, the weight of the structure above to other structural elements below. It may also represent such a member from an architectural point of view in which case it may represent a non load bearing element. Whether it is a structural load bearing element or a non-load bearing element is determined by the [[Pset_ColumnCommon]].[[LoadBearing]] property.

row.value: Un [[IfcColumn]] es un elemento estructural o arquitectónico vertical que, a menudo está alineado con una intersección de una rejilla estructural. En la mayoría de los casos representa a un componente estructural vertical, o casi vertical, que transmite, mediante compresión, el peso de la estructura superior a otros elementos estructurales inferiores. También puede representar a dicho componente desde un punto de vista arquitectónico, en cuyo caso no es necesario que soporte carga. La propiedad [[Pset_ColumnCommon]].[[LoadBearing]] determina si es un elemento con capacidad portante o no.
es-ES

value.original: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.

row.value: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.
EN

value.original: A covering is an element which covers some part of another element and is fully dependent on that other element. The [[IfcCovering]] defines the occurrence of a covering type, that (if given) is expressed by the IfcCoveringType.

row.value: Un tipo de revestimiento es un elemento que cubre alguna parte de otro elemento y es totalmente dependiente de ese otro elemento. El CoveringType define la categoría de un tipo de revestimiento, que (si se da) se expresa mediante el IfcCoveringType.
es-ES

value.original: A curtain wall is a wall of a building which is an assembly of components, hung from the edge of the floor/roof structure rather than bearing on a floor. Curtain wall is represented as a building element assembly and implemented as a subtype of [[IfcBuiltElement]] that uses an IfcRelAggregates relationship. A curtain wall is often external, but using [[Pset_CurtainWallCommon]].[[IsExternal]] can be used to define interior curtain walls.

row.value: Grupo de propiedades comunes de muro cortina.
es-ES

value.original: The distribution element [[IfcDistributionControlElement]] defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.

row.value: The distribution element [[IfcDistributionControlElement]] defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.
EN

value.original: The door is a built element that is predominately used to provide controlled access for people, goods, animals and vehicles. It includes constructions with hinged, pivoted, sliding, and additionally revolving and folding operations.

row.value: La puerta es un elemento constructivo que se utiliza fundamentalmente para proporcionar acceso controlado a personas, bienes, animales y vehículos. Incluye elementos constructivos con mecanismos de apertura con bisagras, elementos pivotantes, deslizantes o mecanismos suplementarios de plegado o giratorios.
es-ES

value.original: A duct fitting is a junction or transition in a ducted flow distribution system or used to connect duct segments, resulting in changes in flow characteristics to the fluid such as direction and flow rate.

row.value: Una conexión de conductos es una unión o transición en un sistema de distribución de flujo canalizado o usado para conectar tramos de conductos, lo que resulta en cambios en las características de flujo del fluido, tales como la dirección y el caudal.
es-ES

value.original: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.

row.value: Un tramo de conducto se utiliza normalmente para unir dos secciones de la red de conductos.
es-ES

value.original: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.

row.value: Un aparato eléctrico es un dispositivo destinado al empleo por el usuario que funciona con electricidad.
es-ES

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcEnergyConversionDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device used to perform energy conversion or heat transfer and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcEnergyConversionDeviceType or its subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcEnergyConversionDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device used to perform energy conversion or heat transfer and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcEnergyConversionDeviceType or its subtypes.
EN

value.original: A fire suppression terminal has the purpose of delivering a fluid (gas or liquid) that will suppress a fire.

row.value: A fire suppression terminal has the purpose of delivering a fluid (gas or liquid) that will suppress a fire.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowController]] defines the occurrence of elements of a distribution system that are used to regulate flow through a distribution system. Examples include dampers, valves, switches, and relays. Its type is defined by IfcFlowControllerType or subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowController]] defines the occurrence of elements of a distribution system that are used to regulate flow through a distribution system. Examples include dampers, valves, switches, and relays. Its type is defined by IfcFlowControllerType or subtypes.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowFitting]] defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system, such as an elbow or tee. Its type is defined by IfcFlowFittingType or its subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowFitting]] defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system, such as an elbow or tee. Its type is defined by IfcFlowFittingType or its subtypes.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowMovingDevice]] defines the occurrence of an apparatus used to distribute, circulate or perform conveyance of fluids, including liquids and gases (such as a pump or fan), and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowMovingDeviceType or its subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowMovingDevice]] defines the occurrence of an apparatus used to distribute, circulate or perform conveyance of fluids, including liquids and gases (such as a pump or fan), and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowMovingDeviceType or its subtypes.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowSegment]] defines the occurrence of a segment of a flow distribution system.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowSegment]] defines the occurrence of a segment of a flow distribution system.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowStorageDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device that participates in a distribution system and is used for temporary storage (such as a tank). Its type is defined by IfcFlowStorageDeviceType or its subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowStorageDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device that participates in a distribution system and is used for temporary storage (such as a tank). Its type is defined by IfcFlowStorageDeviceType or its subtypes.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowTerminal]] defines the occurrence of a permanently attached element that acts as a terminus or beginning of a distribution system (such as an air outlet, drain, water closet, or sink). A terminal is typically a point at which a system interfaces with an external environment. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTerminalType or its subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowTerminal]] defines the occurrence of a permanently attached element that acts as a terminus or beginning of a distribution system (such as an air outlet, drain, water closet, or sink). A terminal is typically a point at which a system interfaces with an external environment. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTerminalType or its subtypes.
EN

value.original: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowTreatmentDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device typically used to remove unwanted matter from a fluid, either liquid or gas, and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTreatmentDeviceType or its subtypes.

row.value: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowTreatmentDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device typically used to remove unwanted matter from a fluid, either liquid or gas, and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTreatmentDeviceType or its subtypes.
EN

value.original: A footing is a part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load to the soil. A footing is also characterized as shallow foundation, where the loads are transferred to the ground near the surface.

row.value: A footing is a part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load to the soil. A footing is also characterized as shallow foundation, where the loads are transferred to the ground near the surface.
EN

value.original: A furnishing element is a generalization of all furniture related objects. Furnishing objects are characterized as being

row.value: Un elemento de mobiliario es una generalización de todos los objetos relacionados con los muebles.
es-ES

value.original: Furniture defines complete furnishings such as a table, desk, chair, or cabinet, which may or may not be permanently attached to a building structure.

row.value: Furniture defines complete furnishings such as a table, desk, chair, or cabinet, which may or may not be permanently attached to a building structure.
EN

value.original: A light fixture is a container that is designed for the purpose of housing one or more lamps and optionally devices that control, restrict or vary their emission.

row.value: Una luminaria es un contenedor diseñado para albergar una o más lámparas y opcionalmente dispositivos que controlan restringen o varían su emisión.
es-ES

value.original: An [[IfcMember]] is a structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support. It is not required to be load bearing. The orientation of the member (being horizontal, vertical or sloped) is not relevant to its definition (in contrary to [[IfcBeam]] and [[IfcColumn]]). An [[IfcMember]] represents a linear structural element from an architectural or structural modeling point of view and shall be used if it cannot be expressed more specifically as either an [[IfcBeam]] or an [[IfcColumn]].

row.value: Un [[IfcMember]] es un miembro estructural diseñado para llevar cargas entre o más allá de los puntos de apoyo. No es necesario ser portador de carga. La orientación del miembro (siendo horizontal, vertical o pendiente) no es relevante para su definición (en contra de [[IfcBeam]] y [[IfcColumn]]). Un [[IfcMember]] representa un elemento estructural lineal desde un punto de vista de modelado arquitectónico o estructural y se utilizará si no puede expresarse más específicamente como [[IfcBeam]] o como [[IfcColumn]].
es-ES

value.original: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids. It represents a void within any element that has physical manifestation. Openings can be inserted into walls, slabs, beams, columns, or other elements.

row.value: El hueco es un elemento de abertura, rebaje o marco, que refleja vacíos. Representa un vacío en cualquier elemento con manifestación física. Las aberturas pueden insertarse en muros, losas, vigas, columnas u otros elementos.
es-ES

value.original: A pipe fitting is a junction or transition in a piping flow distribution system used to connect pipe segments, resulting in changes in flow characteristics to the fluid such as direction or flow rate.

row.value: Un accesorio de tubería es una unión o transición en un sistema de distribución de flujos usado para conectar tramos de tuberías, lo que produce cambios en las características de flujo del fluido, tales como dirección o caudal.
es-ES

value.original: A pipe segment is used to typically join two sections of a piping network.

row.value: Un tramo de tubería se utiliza normalmente para unir dos secciones de una red de tuberías.
es-ES

value.original: An [[IfcPlate]] is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness. A plate may carry loads between or beyond points of support, or provide stiffening. The location of the plate (being horizontal, vertical or sloped) is not relevant to its definition.

row.value: Una [[IfcPlate]] es un elemento plano, a menudo con espesor constante. Una placa puede portar cargas entre o más allá de los puntos de apoyo, o proporcionar resistencia. La ubicación de la placa (horizontal, vertical o inclinada) no es relevante para su definición.
es-ES

value.original: The railing is a frame assembly adjacent to human or vehicle circulation spaces and at some space boundaries where it is used in lieu of walls or to complement walls. Designed as an optional physical support, or to prevent injury or damage, either by falling or collision.

row.value: Una barandilla es un conjunto estructural adyacente a espacios de circulación humana o vehicular y utilizado como límite en algunos espacios, donde se utiliza en lugar de paredes o como complemento de estas. Está diseñada como soporte físico opcional, o para prevenir lesiones o daños, ya sea por caída o por colisión.
es-ES

value.original: A ramp is a vertical passageway which provides a human or vehicle circulation link between one floor level and another floor level at a different elevation. It may include a landing as an intermediate floor slab. A ramp normally does not include steps.

row.value: Una rampa es un plano vertical que permite la circulación humana o vehicular entre dos niveles situados a diferente altura. Puede incluir un descansillo como losa intermedia. Una rampa no suele incluir peldaños.
es-ES

value.original: A ramp comprises a single inclined segment, or several inclined segments that are connected by a horizontal segment, referred to as a landing. A ramp flight is the single inclined segment and part of the ramp construction. In case of single flight ramps, the ramp flight and the ramp are identical.

row.value: Una rampa incluye un único tramo inclinado, o varios tramos inclinados conectados por un tramo horizontal llamado descansillo. Un tramo de rampa es el elemento inclinado que forma parte de la construcción de una rampa. En el caso de rampas de un único tramo, el tramo de la rampa y la rampa coinciden.
es-ES

value.original: A reinforcing bar is usually made of steel with manufactured deformations in the surface, and used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength. A single instance of this class may represent one or many of actual rebars, for example a row of rebars.

row.value: A reinforcing bar is usually made of steel with manufactured deformations in the surface, and used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength. A single instance of this class may represent one or many of actual rebars, for example a row of rebars.
EN

value.original: A roof is the covering of the top part of a building, it protects the building against the effects of weather.

row.value: Una cubierta es el elemento que cubre la parte superior de un edificio y lo protege de los efectos meteorológicos.
es-ES

value.original: A slab is a component of the construction that may enclose a space vertically. The slab may provide the lower support (floor) or upper construction (roof slab) in any space in a building.

row.value: Una losa es un elemento de construcción que puede cerrar un espacio verticalmente. La losa puede proporcionar soporte inferior (suelo) o cerramiento superior (techo) en cualquier espacio de un edificio.
es-ES

value.original: A stair is a vertical passageway allowing occupants to walk (step) from one floor level to another floor level at a different elevation. It may include a landing as an intermediate floor slab.

row.value: Una escalera es una conexión vertical que permite a los ocupantes caminar, utilizando escalones, entre niveles de planta situados a diferente altura. Puede incluir un rellano como nivel intermedio.
es-ES

value.original: A stair flight is an assembly of building components in a single 'run' of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing). The stair steps and any stringers are included in the stair flight. A winder is also regarded a part of a stair flight.

row.value: Un tramo de escalera es un conjunto de elementos constructivos en una única sucesión de escalones (no interrumpida por un rellano intermedio). Los escalones y zancas están incluidos en el tramo de escalera.
es-ES

value.original: A switch is used in a cable distribution system (electrical circuit) to control or modulate the flow of electricity.

row.value: Un interruptor se utiliza en un sistema de distribución de cables (circuito eléctrico) para controlar o modular el flujo de electricidad.
es-ES

value.original: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.

row.value: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.
EN

value.original: A transport element is a generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a Facility. The [[IfcTransportElement]] defines the occurrence of a transport element, that (if given), is expressed by the IfcTransportElementType.

row.value: Un elemento de transporte es una generalización de todos los objetos relacionados con el transporte que desplazan personas, animales o mercancías dentro de una instalación. El [[IfcTransportElement]] define la instancia de un elemento de transporte, que (si se da) se expresa con el IfcTransportElementType.
es-ES

value.original: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.

row.value: Una válvula se utiliza en un sistema de distribución de tuberías de servicios de un edificio para controlar o modular el flujo del fluido.
es-ES

value.original: The wall represents a vertical construction that may bound or subdivide spaces. Wall are usually vertical, or nearly vertical, planar elements, often designed to bear structural loads. A wall is however not required to be load bearing.

row.value: Un muro representa una construcción vertical que puede enlazar o subdividir espacios. Los muros son normalmente elementos planos, verticales, o casi verticales, a menudo diseñados para soportar cargas estructurales. No obstante, un muro no tiene por qué ser portante.
es-ES

value.original: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air. It includes vertical opening but also horizontal opening such as skylights or light domes. It includes constructions with swinging, pivoting, sliding, or revolving panels and fixed panels. A window consists of a lining and one or several panels.

row.value: Una ventana es un elemento de construcción que se utiliza principalmente para proporcionar luz natural y aire fresco. Incluye apertura vertical pero también apertura horizontal como claraboyas o cúpulas de luz. Incluye construcciones con paneles oscilobatientes, pivotantes, deslizantes o giratorios y paneles fijos. Una ventana consta de un revestimiento y uno o varios paneles.
es-ES

value.original: An air outlet or inlet, such as a grille or diffuser, where ducted air enters or leaves a room.

row.value: Una boca de salida o de entrada de aire, como una rejilla o un difusor, por donde el aire canalizado entra o sale de una sala.

value.original: A device that warns people of fire or another danger by sound or light, such as a bell, siren or beacon.

row.value: Un dispositivo que avisa a las personas de un incendio u otro peligro mediante sonido o luz, como una campana, una sirena o un piloto luminoso.

value.original: A horizontal or nearly horizontal structural member that carries loads across a span, usually onto columns or walls.

row.value: Un elemento estructural horizontal o casi horizontal que soporta cargas a lo largo de un vano, normalmente apoyado en pilares o muros.

value.original: One part of a larger building element, such as a single layer or piece of a wall or slab, kept as its own object.

row.value: Una parte de un elemento de construcción mayor, como una capa o una pieza de un muro o de una losa, guardada como objeto independiente.

value.original: An element that the source model did not give a specific type, so it is kept as a general building element.

row.value: Un elemento al que el modelo de origen no asignó un tipo concreto, por lo que se conserva como elemento de construcción general.

value.original: A fitting that joins, bends or branches cable trays, cable ladders or trunking.

row.value: Una pieza que une, curva o ramifica bandejas portacables, escalerillas o canaletas.

value.original: A straight run of cable tray, cable ladder, trunking or conduit that carries and protects cables.

row.value: Un tramo recto de bandeja portacables, escalerilla, canaleta o tubo protector que sostiene y protege los cables.

value.original: A vertical structural member that carries loads from beams and slabs down towards the foundations.

row.value: Un elemento estructural vertical que transmite las cargas de las vigas y los forjados hacia la cimentación.

value.original: A device that controls a system from the signals it receives, such as a thermostat, timer or control panel.

row.value: Un dispositivo que controla una instalación a partir de las señales que recibe, como un termostato, un temporizador o un cuadro de control.

value.original: A finishing layer over another element, such as a ceiling, floor finish, cladding or insulation.

row.value: Una capa de acabado sobre otro elemento, como un falso techo, un acabado de suelo, un revestimiento o un aislamiento.

value.original: An outer wall of panels, often glass, hung on a frame fixed to the building; it carries no floor loads.

row.value: Un muro exterior de paneles, a menudo de vidrio, colgado de una estructura fijada al edificio; no soporta las cargas de los forjados.

value.original: A control or sensing device of a building system, such as a sensor or actuator, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un dispositivo de control o de medición de una instalación del edificio, como un sensor o un actuador, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: A door: a leaf in its frame that opens to let people pass through a wall or partition.

row.value: Una puerta: una hoja dentro de su marco que se abre para dejar pasar a las personas a través de un muro o tabique.

value.original: A duct piece that joins, bends, branches or changes the size of air ducts.

row.value: Una pieza de conducto que une, curva, ramifica o cambia el tamaño de los conductos de aire.

value.original: A straight length of air duct that carries air between equipment and rooms.

row.value: Un tramo recto de conducto de aire que lleva el aire entre los equipos y las salas.

value.original: An electrical appliance connected to the building supply, such as a fridge, oven or water heater.

row.value: Un electrodoméstico conectado a la red eléctrica del edificio, como un frigorífico, un horno o un calentador de agua.

value.original: Equipment that turns one form of energy into another, such as a boiler, chiller or transformer, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un equipo que convierte una forma de energía en otra, como una caldera, una enfriadora o un transformador, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: A fire-fighting outlet, such as a sprinkler head, hose reel or fire hydrant.

row.value: Una salida para la lucha contra incendios, como un rociador, una boca de incendio equipada o un hidrante.

value.original: A device that regulates flow in a pipe, duct or circuit, such as a valve, damper or switch, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un dispositivo que regula el caudal en una tubería, un conducto o un circuito, como una válvula, una compuerta o un interruptor, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: A fitting that joins, bends or branches pipes, ducts or cable runs, with no more specific type.

row.value: Una pieza que une, curva o ramifica tuberías, conductos o canalizaciones de cables, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: A type of gauge or meter, such as a pressure gauge, thermometer or voltmeter.

row.value: Un tipo de manómetro o contador, como un manómetro de presión, un termómetro o un voltímetro.

value.original: Equipment that moves a fluid, such as a pump, fan or compressor, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un equipo que mueve un fluido, como una bomba, un ventilador o un compresor, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: A straight run of pipe, duct or cable carrier, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un tramo recto de tubería, conducto o canalización de cables, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: Equipment that stores a fluid or energy, such as a tank or battery, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un equipo que almacena un fluido o energía, como un depósito o una batería, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: The end point where a system serves a room or a person, such as a tap, light or socket, with no more specific type.

row.value: El punto final donde una instalación da servicio a una sala o a una persona, como un grifo, una luz o un enchufe, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: Equipment that cleans or treats a fluid, such as a filter or separator, with no more specific type.

row.value: Un equipo que limpia o trata un fluido, como un filtro o un separador, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: A foundation element, such as a pad or strip footing, that spreads the load of the building into the ground.

row.value: Un elemento de cimentación, como una zapata aislada o corrida, que reparte la carga del edificio sobre el terreno.

value.original: A piece of furniture or equipment placed in a room, with no more specific type.

row.value: Una pieza de mobiliario o de equipamiento colocada en una sala, sin un tipo más específico.

value.original: Furniture, such as a table, chair, bed, desk or cabinet.

row.value: Mobiliario, como una mesa, una silla, una cama, un escritorio o un armario.

value.original: A light fitting (luminaire) that holds lamps and lights a space.

row.value: Una luminaria que sostiene las lámparas e ilumina un espacio.

value.original: A structural or framing piece that is not a main beam or column, such as a brace, stud, mullion or purlin.

row.value: Una pieza estructural o de armazón que no es una viga ni un pilar principal, como un arriostramiento, un montante, un parteluz o una correa.

value.original: A void cut into a wall, slab or other element, usually for a door or window or to let services pass.

row.value: Un hueco practicado en un muro, una losa u otro elemento, normalmente para una puerta o una ventana o para dejar pasar instalaciones.

value.original: A pipe piece that joins, bends, branches or changes the size of pipes, such as an elbow, tee or reducer.

row.value: Una pieza de tubería que une, curva, ramifica o cambia el tamaño de las tuberías, como un codo, una te o una reducción.

value.original: A straight length of pipe that carries water, gas or another fluid.

row.value: Un tramo recto de tubería que lleva agua, gas u otro fluido.

value.original: A thin flat element, such as a steel plate or a glass panel in a curtain wall.

row.value: Un elemento plano y delgado, como una chapa de acero o un panel de vidrio de un muro cortina.

value.original: A guard rail, handrail or balustrade, for example along a stair, ramp or balcony edge.

row.value: Una barandilla, un pasamanos o una balaustrada, por ejemplo en el borde de una escalera, una rampa o un balcón.

value.original: A sloped walkway joining two levels, made of one or more ramp flights and landings.

row.value: Un paso inclinado que une dos niveles, formado por uno o más tramos de rampa y descansos.

value.original: One sloped run of a ramp between two landings.

row.value: Un tramo inclinado de una rampa entre dos descansos.

value.original: A steel reinforcing bar (rebar) set inside concrete to carry tension.

row.value: Una barra de acero de refuerzo (armadura) colocada dentro del hormigón para resistir la tracción.

value.original: The roof: the top covering of a building, made of slabs, beams and other parts.

row.value: La cubierta: el cierre superior de un edificio, formado por losas, vigas y otras partes.

value.original: A type of sensor that detects a condition, such as smoke, heat, temperature or movement.

row.value: Un tipo de sensor que detecta una condición, como humo, calor, temperatura o movimiento.

value.original: A flat horizontal or nearly horizontal element, such as a floor, roof slab or landing, usually of concrete.

row.value: Un elemento plano horizontal o casi horizontal, como un suelo, una losa de cubierta o un descanso, normalmente de hormigón.

value.original: A stair joining two levels, made of one or more flights and landings.

row.value: Una escalera que une dos niveles, formada por uno o más tramos y descansos.

value.original: One run of steps of a stair between two landings.

row.value: Un tramo de peldaños de una escalera entre dos descansos.

value.original: A device that turns an electrical circuit on or off, such as a switch, circuit breaker or contactor.

row.value: Un dispositivo que conecta o desconecta un circuito eléctrico, como un interruptor, un disyuntor o un contactor.

value.original: A part of a modular office furniture system, such as a screen panel, work surface or storage unit.

row.value: Una parte de un sistema de mobiliario modular de oficina, como un panel separador, una superficie de trabajo o un módulo de almacenaje.

value.original: Equipment that moves people or goods, such as a lift (elevator), escalator or moving walkway.

row.value: Un equipo que mueve personas o mercancías, como un ascensor, una escalera mecánica o un pasillo rodante.

value.original: A valve that opens, closes or regulates the flow in a pipe.

row.value: Una válvula que abre, cierra o regula el paso del fluido en una tubería.

value.original: A wall: a vertical element that divides or encloses spaces; it may or may not carry load.

row.value: Un muro: un elemento vertical que divide o cierra espacios; puede soportar carga o no.

value.original: A wall of even thickness along its length (an older IFC name, treated today as a plain wall).

row.value: Un muro de espesor uniforme a lo largo de su longitud (un nombre IFC antiguo, que hoy se trata como un muro normal).

value.original: A window: a framed opening, usually glazed, that lets in light and air.

row.value: Una ventana: un hueco con marco, normalmente acristalado, que deja entrar luz y aire.

value.original: A flow instrument reads and displays the value of a particular property of a system at a point, or displays the difference in the value of a property between two points.

row.value: A flow instrument reads and displays the value of a particular property of a system at a point, or displays the difference in the value of a property between two points.
